title: Strong recommendations and conditional referrals
summary: This topic centers on owners explicitly recommending the G60 for attributes like hybrid suitability, economy, design, family use, and general satisfaction, with a smaller set of comments about conditional or withheld recommendations and engine stop behavior.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe strong willingness to recommend the G60, often tied to satisfaction, hybrid appeal, economy, design, family usability, and recommending it to friends.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on dislike of the engine turning off, which is paired with an unfavorable recommendation stance in the sampled feedback.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention conditional recommendations, requests for broader customer-response improvements, or strong feelings that do not clearly resolve into a direct vehicle evaluation.

limitations: Several fragments are very short recommendation statements with limited context about the underlying ownership experience.
Some undetermined examples imply positive or negative leanings, but the supplied labels do not support reassigning them.
The topic includes both direct vehicle recommendations and broader comments about customer experience or brand quality, which reduces coherence.
